description: Add or extend an attribute on an existing node type; use to add a field or merge new enum values into an existing one. If the attribute name doesn't exist, it is created. If it exists and is a select/multiselect, new values are merged in (existing values kept). Date values on nodes are written via naumu_update_node as either an ISO date string "YYYY-MM-DD" (single day) or an object { start, end? } with ISO date strings (inclusive range). A "person" attribute holds one space member (or several when `multiple` is true); write it on a node by member name or email and the server stores the member id. Strongly encouraged to provide `description` on the attribute and on each value - short, contrastive notes (e.g. attribute "stage - sales funnel position; distinct from status which captures health/blockers", value "closed-won - deal signed and revenue committed"). Descriptions are the single strongest signal future agents use when picking which attribute/value to set.

description.description: Short note explaining what this attribute captures and how it differs from similarly-named attributes elsewhere in the schema (e.g. "Sales funnel position; differs from `status` which captures health/blockers"). Strongly encouraged.

multiple.description: person only - allow several members. Omit to leave the stored flag unchanged.

node_type.description: Existing node type to add the attribute to.

requiredOnWrite.description: True when every write that creates or updates a node of this type must also set this attribute (e.g. "Next contact" on a Company). Omit to leave the stored flag unchanged.

type.description: Attribute type (required). select/multiselect define a closed set of categories - provide their values. string/number/boolean/date/person hold per-node data - pass values: []. A specific calendar date is per-node data, so use type "date" and write the date on the node, rather than adding the date as a select value. "person" references one space member (an owner, assignee, account manager).

description.description: Short note distinguishing this value from sibling values (e.g. "closed-won - deal signed and revenue committed"). Encouraged when the label alone is ambiguous.

name: naumu_add_attribute
title: Add Attribute to Node Type
